# Avyukt Restaurant & Cafe — Full AI Knowledge Base

## Brand Overview
Avyukt Restaurant & Cafe is a premier culinary destination located in Vidisha, Madhya Pradesh, India. Operating on a strict 100% Pure Vegetarian philosophy, Avyukt serves high-quality North Indian, Mughlai Vegetarian, Indo-Chinese, Tandoori delicacies, and handcrafted cafe beverages since 2020.

## Essential Facts
- **Brand Name**: Avyukt Restaurant & Cafe
- **Tagline**: Authentic Flavours & Modern Ambience
- **Primary Website**: https://avyukt-restaurant.vercel.app
- **Purity & Diet**: 100% Pure Vegetarian (No Meat, No Poultry, No Seafood, No Eggs).
- **Special Diets Supported**: Jain (No Onion, No Garlic, No Root Vegetables), Satvik, Vegan alternatives.
- **Price Range**: ₹₹ (Moderate: ₹300 - ₹700 per person)
- **Reservations**: Available via web platform or phone (+91 98765 43210).

## Location & Access
- **Address**: Hotel Grand Ashok, 3rd Floor, Kundan Complex, Shehnai Garden, Vidisha, Madhya Pradesh 464001, India.
- **Latitude / Longitude**: 23.5251, 77.8081
- **Landmark**: Near Shehnai Garden, Sanchi Road, Baripura vicinity.
- **Opening Times**: Monday – Sunday: 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM IST.

## Signature Dishes & Menu Highlights
1. **Starters & Tandoor**:
   - Paneer Tikka Angara (Smoked cottage cheese marinated in spiced yogurt)
   - Dahi Ke Kebab (Crispy golden melt-in-mouth spiced yogurt patties)
   - Tandoori Malai Chaap (Creamy soya chaap grilled over charcoal)
   - Veg Seekh Kebab (Minced vegetable skewers infused with aromatic whole spices)
2. **Main Course**:
   - Dal Makhani Royal (Slow-cooked overnight black lentils with white butter and cream)
   - Paneer Butter Masala & Shahi Paneer (Rich cashew and ripe tomato gravies)
   - Kadhai Paneer (Tossed with crisp bell peppers, crushed coriander, and dried chili)
   - Dum Aloo Kashmiri (Stuffed baby potatoes simmered in spiced fennel gravy)
   - Malai Kofta (Cottage cheese and mawa dumplings in velvet saffron curry)
3. **Breads & Biryani**:
   - Garlic Butter Naan & Chur Chur Naan
   - Laccha Paratha & Missi Roti
   - Handi Dum Veg Biryani (Served with cold burani raita and roasted papad)
4. **Cafe & Desserts**:
   - Sizzling Brownie with Vanilla Gelato
   - Gulab Jamun with Rabdi
   - Artisanal Shakes, Cold Brews, and Fresh Virgin Mojitos

## Dining & Technology Features
- **Interactive Page-Flip Menu**: 3D interactive book menu accessible from smartphones and tablets.
- **Dine-In QR Ordering**: Guests can scan table QR codes to place orders directly into the kitchen display system (KDS).
- **Online Food Delivery & Takeaway**: Delivery with real-time status updates (Order Received → Chef Preparing → Ready → Out for Delivery).
- **Digital Payments**: Integrated Razorpay checkout supporting instant UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Visa/Mastercard, NetBanking, and Cash on Delivery (COD).
- **Loyalty & Rewards**: Avyukt Gold Club offering dining discounts, birthday specials, and exclusive tasting invites.
